description: Guests specifically asking to check in anytime before their scheduled check-in time.
Guests specifically asking to check out anytime after their scheduled check-out time.
Guests asking for a discount on their stay, including asks for a reduction or elimination in any fees related to the stay.
Guests asking for a refund for any payment that they had previously made related to their stay.
Guests asking to change their reservation, including changing the dates of their stay, the number of guests, the type of room, or cancelling their reservation.
